title: Keep a complete task-sync export's discarded or reverted tasks owed after an incremental import
outcome: Keep a complete task-sync export's discarded or reverted tasks owed after an incremental import
acceptance: After `export --rebuild` whose folder is discarded before a commit, an incremental import over moved commits leaves the rebuilt tasks owed to the next export, or refuses by name
After a committed `export --rebuild`, another host's exact revert of a rebuilt task is taken by the next incremental import
